_description: EB 100D leave-two-out: pca_dim=100, hold out t1 and t3, train on t0/t2/t4. The canonical config is eb_l2o.json, which bakes in the best result from the v3 ablation deep-dive (IMF + sigmoid slope=12 + mu=0 + strength=1000 + Gaussian width=0.33; 5-seed Avg MMD = 0.0670 +/- 0.0009). Avg MMD = (mmd_t1 + mmd_t3 + 2 * mmd_rest) / 4. This file is documentation only and is not loaded by train.py.
